question: Where was the All India Masters Ranking Badminton Tournament 2025 held from 22-29 January 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Panchkula, Haryana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **All India Masters Ranking Badminton Tournament 2025** was successfully organized in **Panchkula**, **Haryana**, from **22nd to 29th January 2025**. This event is a premier competition for veteran badminton players across the country.
 
• The tournament took place at the prestigious **Tau Devi Lal Sports Complex**, which is a multi-sport facility known for hosting high-profile national and international events.
 
• This ranking tournament serves as a critical selection ground for Indian athletes aiming to represent the nation at the **BWF World Senior (Masters) Championships**. Hence, the statement regarding its location in **Haryana** is correct.
 
• The event witnessed participation from over **1,500 athletes**, showcasing the growing popularity of masters sports in **India**. The competition was held across various age brackets, starting from **35+ years** up to **75+ years**.
 
• The **Badminton Association of India (BAI)**, in collaboration with the **Haryana Badminton Association**, oversaw the technical and administrative aspects of the tournament to ensure it met international standards.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Badminton Association of India (BAI):**

 
 
• The **BAI** is the governing body for badminton in **India**. It is registered under the **Societies Registration Act**.
 
• The current **President** of **BAI** is **Dr. Himanta Biswa Sarma**. The organization is headquartered in **New Delhi**.
 
• It is responsible for organizing national championships, managing the national team, and promoting the sport at the grassroots level.
 
 
 
• **Masters Badminton Classification:**
 
 
• Masters or "Senior" badminton is specifically designed for players who have retired from professional circuits but continue to compete.
 
• The categories are divided into 5-year intervals: **35+**, **40+**, **45+**, **50+**, **55+**, **60+**, **65+**, **70+**, and **75+**.
 
• Events included in this tournament are **Men’s Singles**, **Women’s Singles**, **Men’s Doubles**, **Women’s Doubles**, and **Mixed Doubles**.
 
 
 
• **Sports Infrastructure in Haryana:**
 
 
• **Haryana** is often referred to as the "Sports Hub" of **India** due to its high density of elite athletes and world-class facilities.
 
• The **Tau Devi Lal Sports Complex** in **Sector 3, Panchkula**, has previously hosted the **Khelo India Youth Games 2021** (held in **2022**) and several **Pro Kabaddi League** matches.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Significance of Ranking:** The points earned in this tournament contribute to the **National Ranking** of the players. High-ranking players receive preference for international entries in tournaments sanctioned by the **Badminton World Federation (BWF)**.
 
• **BWF World Senior Championships:** These are held biennially. The **2025** edition of the **BWF World Senior Championships** is a major target for the winners of the **Panchkula** ranking tournament.
 
• **Health and Fitness:** The tournament highlights the importance of lifelong fitness, encouraging individuals in their **40s**, **50s**, and beyond to maintain an active lifestyle through competitive sports.
 
• **Year 2025 Calendar:** The **January 2025** slot is strategically placed at the beginning of the sporting calendar to allow players enough time to prepare for international summer and autumn circuits.
